work.title: The Life and Death of King Richard the Second
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 3, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. The coast of Wales. A castle in view.
scene.location: The coast of Wales. A castle in view.

content.text: Flourish: drums and trumpets. Enter King Richard, the Bishop of Carlisle, Aumerle and soldiers.

lines.text: Barkloughly Castle call they this at hand?
lines.plainText: Barkloughly Castle call they this at hand
